# esp-web-tools 10.4.0

This directory contains the prebuilt browser distribution of
[`esp-web-tools`](https://github.com/esphome/esp-web-tools) version 10.4.0.
It is vendored locally so the online firmware installer does not depend on a
third-party CDN at runtime.

The upstream project is licensed under Apache-2.0. See `LICENSE` in this
directory.
